0.heading: Overview
refs: 1Ki 8:1 , The feast of the dedication of the temple

1.heading: AM 3000, BC 1004
refs: This did not take place, according to Abp. Usher, till the year after the temple was finished, because that year was a jubilee. "The 8th day of the 7th month, viz. the 30th of our October, being Friday, was the first of the seven days of dedication
the 10th day, Saturday, November 1, the fast of expiation or atonement was held
whereon, according to the Levitical law, the jubilee was proclaimed by sound of trumpet. The 15th day, Friday, was the feast of tabernacles, which was always very solemnly kept
and the day following, Nov.14, being our Saturday, when the Sabbath was ended, the people returned home." 2Ch 5:2-10
1.body:
Solomon:
This did not take place, according to Abp. Usher, till the year after the temple was finished, because that year was a jubilee. "The 8th day of the 7th month, viz. the 30th of our October, being Friday, was the first of the seven days of dedication; the 10th day, Saturday, November 1, the fast of expiation or atonement was held; whereon, according to the Levitical law, the jubilee was proclaimed by sound of trumpet. The 15th day, Friday, was the feast of tabernacles, which was always very solemnly kept; and the day following, Nov.14, being our Saturday, when the Sabbath was ended, the people returned home." 2Ch 5:2-10

none that is not liable to transgress.

refs: We are not to suppose that all these victims were sacrificed in one day, or on one altar

66.body:
